name: order
title: Draft order confirmation / purchase order
for_each: select id,name from orders where status<>'cancelled' order by name

sections.title: Lines
sections.note: Amounts exclude tax. Confirm delivery and tax treatment before issuing.
sections.sql: select i.name item,i.unit,l.quantity,l.completed,l.unit_price from order_lines l join items i on i.id=l.item_id where order_id=$1 order by i.name

name: intercompany
title: Draft intercompany confirmation
for_each: select id,name from intercompany where side='receivable' order by name

sections.title: Counterparty confirmation
sections.note: Operational reconciliation, not a tax invoice or elimination journal.
sections.sql: select v.* from v_intercompany v join intercompany i on i.name=v.reference and i.currency=v.currency join subsidiaries s on s.id=i.subsidiary_id and s.name=v.seller where i.id=$1

name: retention
title: Record retention review
for_each: select id,name from subsidiaries order by name

sections.title: Evidence register
sections.note: Confirm legal holds and longer obligations with the accountant.
sections.sql: select name,period_end,retain_until,archive_ref,last_backup from evidence where subsidiary_id=$1 order by name
